collocations: authority; authorization; military force, an army,” from Anglo-French
pouair, Old French povoir, noun use of the infinitive, “to be able,” earlier
power an electric car：驱动一辆电动汽车
electric power：电力
economic power：经济强国

the power struggle：权力斗争
to take / seize / lose power：掌握 / 夺取 / 失掉政权
words.definition: 权力；能力；（法律赋予的）权力；强国 vt. 为……提供动力 n. 电动的
words.etymology: c. 1300, “ability; ability to act or do; strength, vigor, might,” especially in battle; “efficacy; control, mastery, lordship, dominion; legal power or podir (9c.), from Vulgar Latin *potere, from Latin potis “powerful” (from PIE root *poti- “powerful; lord”).
examples: His power extends beyond the seas. 他的势力扩展到海外。
words.mnemonic: power：ability to act or do→能力；权力；动力

collocations: an immensely powerful organization：有巨大影响力的组织
a powerful engine：大功率引擎

a powerful image / drug / speech：
鲜明的形象；有奇效的药物；有力的演说
words.definition: 有影响力的；强有力的；效力大的
words.mnemonic: power（能力）+ -ful（充满…的）→充满能力的→有影响力的；强有

collocations: powerless minorities：弱势的少数族群
words.definition: 无影响力的；无能为力的

examples:
The movement actively empowered women and gave them confidence in
themselves.
这场运动使妇女更能主动掌握自己的命运，对自己充满信心
words.mnemonic: em-（使……）+ power（能力）→使有能力做……→授权；使能够

examples:
This government believes very strongly in the empowerment of women.
这届政府坚信赋权于妇女。

collocations: a need for trained / skilled manpower：对受过培训的 / 熟练的劳动力的需
a manpower shortage：劳动力短缺
words.mnemonic: man（人）+ power（能力）→劳动者的能力→劳动力

collocations: a powerfully emotive song：激动人心的歌曲
be powerfully built：身体魁梧健壮
argue powerfully for reform：为改革进行了有力的辩论
an economic powerhouse：经济强国
words.definition: 强国；权势集团；精力充沛的人
words.mnemonic: power（权力，力量）+ house（场地）→权力、力量充满的地方→强

collocations: a 300-horsepower engine：一台300马力的发动机
words.mnemonic: horse（马）+ power（力量）→马力（功率单位）

collocations: high-powered lasers：大功率激光器
a high-powered lawyer：身居要职的律师。
words.definition: 大功率的；（人）身居要职的；（职位）要求高的
words.mnemonic:
high（高的）+ powered（由……驱动的）→高功率驱动的，（职位）
要求高的→大功率的；（人）身居要职的

collocations: superior firepower：更胜一筹的火力
unroll firepower：火力全开
examples:

这家公司财力雄厚。
words.mnemonic: fire（火）+ power（力量）→火力；比喻义实力
